excerpts.exact_text: amend the Charter, the Bylaws, or any other similar organizational document
propose or adopt a plan of complete or partial liquidation, dissolution, merger, consolidation, restructuring, recapitalization or other reorganization

issue, sell, deliver or agree or commit to issue, sell or deliver (whether through the issuance or granting of options, warrants, commitments, subscriptions, rights to purchase or otherwise) any Company Securities

adjust, split, combine or reclassify any shares of capital stock, or issue or authorize or propose the issuance of any other Company Securities in respect of, in lieu of or in substitution for, any shares of its capital stock or other equity or voting interest

declare, set aside or pay any dividend or other distribution (whether in cash, shares or property or any combination thereof) in respect of any shares of capital stock or other equity or voting interest, or make any other actual, constructive or deemed distribution in respect of any shares of capital stock or other equity or voting interest
incur or assume any Indebtedness
assume, guarantee, endorse or otherwise become liable or responsible (whether directly, contingently or otherwise) for the Indebtedness of any other Person
mortgage or pledge any of its and its Subsidiaries’ assets, tangible or intangible, or create or incur any lien thereupon (other than Permitted Liens)
make any loans, advances or capital contributions to, or investments in, any other Person

sell, assign, transfer, lease, license, sublicense, allow to lapse, abandon, grant a covenant-not-to-assert to a third party with respect to, or otherwise dispose of any material Company Intellectual Property

enter into any change in control, severance or similar agreement or any retention or similar agreement with any officer, employee, director, individual independent contractor, individual consultant, or other individual service provider of the Company Group
settle, consent to or compromise any material Tax claim or assessment or surrender a right to a material Tax refund
consent to any extension or waiver of any limitation period with respect to any material Tax claim or assessment
file an amended Tax Return that could materially increase the Taxes payable by any member of the Company Group
incur or commit to incur any material capital expenditure(s)
modify, amend or terminate any Material Contract
enter into any Contract that would have been a Material Contract if such Contract was in existence as of the date hereof
maintain insurance at less than current levels or otherwise in a manner inconsistent with past practice
enter into any Collective Bargaining Agreement or agreement or arrangement to form a works council or other Contract with any labor union or other labor organization or works council

Except (a) as expressly contemplated by this Agreement or required by applicable law; (b) as set forth in Section 5.1 or Section 5.2 of the Company Disclosure Letter; or (c) as approved by Parent in writing (with email being sufficient) (which approval will not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed)
maintain its existence in good standing (to the extent applicable) pursuant to applicable law
use its commercially reasonable efforts to conduct its business and operations in the ordinary course of business
preserve intact its material assets, properties, Contracts or other legally binding understandings, licenses and business organizations
keep available the services of its current officers and key employees

preserve the current relationships with customers, vendors, distributors, partners (including system integrators, platform partners, referral partners, consulting and implementation partners), lessors, licensors, licensees, creditors, contractors and other Persons with which the Company Group has material business relations

acquire (by merger, consolidation or acquisition of stock or assets) any other Person or any material portion thereof or material equity interest therein or enter into any joint venture, limited liability company or legal partnership or similar arrangement

Except (i) as set forth in Section 5.2 of the Company Disclosure Letter; (ii) as approved by Parent in writing (with email being sufficient) (which approval will not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed); or (iii) as expressly contemplated by the terms of this Agreement or required by applicable law
acquire, lease, license, sell, sell and leaseback, abandon, transfer, assign, guarantee, or exchange any assets, tangible or intangible, in each case in excess of $500,000 individually
encumber or dispose of any Owned Real Property or acquire a fee interest in any material real property in excess of $5,000,000

settlement of any Legal Proceeding or other claim that is (A)(1) reflected or reserved against in the consolidated financial statements of the Company Group as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal quarter of the Company Group included in the Company SEC Reports filed prior to the date hereof and; (2) for solely monetary payments of, net of insurance recovery, no more than $500,000 individually and $2,000,000 in the aggregate

the Company or its applicable Subsidiaries must first, to the extent not prohibited by law, provide Parent and its counsel reasonable advance notice thereof and a reasonable opportunity to review and comment thereon

waive or release any noncompetition, nonsolicitation, nondisclosure, noninterference, nondisparagement, or other restrictive covenant obligation of any current or former employee or independent contractor

adopt or implement any stockholder rights plan or similar arrangement, in each case, applicable to the Merger or any other transaction consummated pursuant to Parent’s rights under Section 5.3(d)(i)(2) or Section 5.3(d)(ii)(2)
enter into, authorize any of, or agree or commit to enter into a Contract to take any of the actions prohibited by this Section 5.2
modify the terms of any shares of its capital stock or other equity or voting interest
